# Guilherme Solski Alves

> Backend software engineer writing Go at Mercado Libre. Part-time co-founder of FINK AI.

## Summary

Guilherme Solski Alves is a backend engineer with 7+ years in production systems, based in Curitiba, Paraná, Brazil. At Mercado Libre (2022–Present) he writes Go for e-commerce platforms serving 1M+ customers and owns observability end to end (OpenTelemetry; New Relic, Grafana, Datadog, Kibana). Part-time co-founder of FINK AI since 2025 (20,000+ users, 4.2M+ financial records). Previously ExxonMobil (Java, Azure/Terraform, Kafka). Open to full-time backend roles (remote or relocation).
